estimator_instances: Counts describe distinct target/predictor specifications, not folds, OLS/Ridge duplication, alpha grids or multilabel output heads.

non_target_coordinates.chart_date: Sampling/observation coordinate, not a song response; chart dates can be predictors at that resolution.
non_target_coordinates.month: Sampling/observation coordinate, not a song response; chart dates can be predictors at that resolution.
non_target_coordinates.snapshot_chart_date: Sampling/observation coordinate, not a song response; chart dates can be predictors at that resolution.
non_target_coordinates.source_chart_index: Sampling/observation coordinate, not a song response; chart dates can be predictors at that resolution.
non_target_coordinates.source_row_index: Sampling/observation coordinate, not a song response; chart dates can be predictors at that resolution.

non_target_identifiers.artist: High-cardinality exact artist-credit identity; not an arbitrary numeric code. New-artist analysis requires a separately approved representation.
non_target_identifiers.mb_release_title: High-cardinality linked-release identity; not an album measurement.
non_target_identifiers.song_id: Exact identity/group key; no numerical or categorical model input.
non_target_identifiers.title: High-cardinality identity text; no validated content encoding in this scalar search.

non_target_population_flag: Bookkeeping/selection indicator; constant in songs/monthly, structural enrichment scope in weekly.
numeric_encoding: Float64 value, train median imputation and one fixed missing indicator per original variable; train-only scaling; constant encoded columns removed per fold.
primary_genre_encoding: 16 fixed taxonomy levels; 15 contrasts with Pop reference plus missing indicator; train-absent columns have zero coefficient; no merging labels.

raw_fields_excluded_globally.artist: High-cardinality exact artist-credit identity; not an arbitrary numeric code. New-artist analysis requires a separately approved representation.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.genre_confidence: Qualitative annotation confidence, not musical content; diagnostic target only.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.in_final_study_population: Bookkeeping/selection indicator; constant in songs/monthly, structural enrichment scope in weekly.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.lyrics_available: Acquisition bookkeeping and deterministic proxy for missing scores; diagnostic target only.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.lyrics_status: Acquisition bookkeeping and direct proxy for score availability; diagnostic target only.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.mb_earliest_release_date: Partial dates represented once as mb_release_year; never invent month/day.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.mb_release_date_precision: Acquisition precision bookkeeping; diagnostic target only.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.mb_release_title: High-cardinality linked-release identity; not an album measurement.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.month: Monthly date alias; use snapshot_chart_date once, not both encodings.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.musicbrainz_match_status: Acquisition bookkeeping; diagnostic target only, never substantive predictor.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.song_id: Exact identity/group key; no numerical or categorical model input.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.source_chart_index: Source coordinate; arbitrary order and row leakage.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.source_row_index: Source coordinate; effectively exposes chart ordering/rank.
raw_fields_excluded_globally.title: High-cardinality identity text; no validated content encoding in this scalar search.

secondary_genres_encoding: 16 multi-hot indicators plus missing indicator; [] is an observed empty set, never missing; one conceptual variable.
